Renewal evidence mirrors `exports.watch` rule 2 verbatim: recorded non-renewal (`auto_renews` false → `stated`) or derivable auto-renewal (`auto_renews` + `notice_window_days` → `renewal_deadline`) is evidenced; everything else stays open. - **`tasks/research_pg.py` — the contract read seam.** `read_contract_expiry_inputs(conn)` — current (`upper_inf`, never superseded) claims on `contract:*` subjects over `{end_date, auto_renews, notice_window_days, renewal_term_months, renewal_options}`; one aggregated row per subject; `[]` on schema mismatch (honest absence). `CLOSING_CONDITION_TEXT["contract_expiring"]` mirrors the catalog's closes verbatim. `DetectorRunSummary.contracts_read` counter.
- **Task ↔ item links (K7 §5.8 / K11 RQ-06 absorbed).** `exports/spine_export` builds the watch payload once before `task_export.build_queue` (`_watch_items_by_subject`); cards gain `watch_items` = the emitted `sig.watch-item/1` handle/kind/title — the item's own handle, never re-derived. `task_export._trigger_lookup` resolves `contract` triggers against `watch_claims` (dict-or-positional rows) → the card's trigger detail names the recorded `end_date`; the K11 title template renders "… contract ending `<date>`". `web/src/pages/watch/item/[handle].astro` links each open task to `/task/<handle>/` when the export emits the card (queue-anchor fallback — never a dead route); `web/src/pages/task/[slug].astro` renders the `Watch:` item link (`ResearchTaskCard.watch_items`).
